release_notes:
1. Full official Pinterest Ads tracking integration (Pinterest Tag pintrk & Conversions API CAPI schemas).
2. Dedicated pinterest namespace in dataLayer containing line_items, product_ids, value, currency, and order_quantity.
3. Dynamic Product Ads catalog matching supporting composite, id_product, and reference_sku strategies.
4. Independent Pinterest switch (PS_GTM_ADV_PINTEREST_ENABLED) and granular 11-event routing matrix (PS_GTM_ADV_PINTEREST_EVENTS).
5. Zero DOM scraping: 100% authoritative backend data sourcing across PrestaShop 1.7.0.0 through 8.x/9.x.
